subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Ransomware as a Business Model
description: A short lesson to help you apply Ransomware as a Business Model.

hook.text: Criminal gangs now run ransomware like a SaaS business. They have support desks and affiliate programs.

buildup.text: Ransomware-as-a-Service lets anyone buy attack tools for a percentage of the ransom collected.

discovery.text: REvil, a ransomware gang, earned over $100 million in one year from ransom payments alone.

twist.text: Many victims pay quietly. Insurance policies sometimes cover ransom, which funds the next attack.

climax.text: Ransomware is now an organized industry with economics, supply chains, and customer service.

punchline.text: Ransomware has a help desk. Crime is a business.

quiz.question: What is Ransomware-as-a-Service?
options: A model where anyone can buy attack tools for a cut of the ransom
A government service to prevent ransomware
